function.name: Sales operations
function.description: Leads, outreach, calls and CRM hygiene.

jobs.name: Draft personalized outreach messages
jobs.outcome: A first message to a prospect is drafted from what is known about them and sent with light edits.

jobs.name: Enrich leads with firmographic and contact data
jobs.outcome: Every new lead is completed with company size, industry, role and contact details from public sources.

jobs.name: Score leads by likelihood to convert
jobs.outcome: Leads are ranked so that working the top of the list converts more than working in order of arrival.

jobs.name: Summarize sales calls into notes and next steps
jobs.outcome: A recorded call becomes notes, objections and next steps a rep would have written.

jobs.name: Update the CRM from calls and emails
jobs.outcome: Fields, stages and next steps in the CRM change to reflect what happened in conversations, without manual entry.
